benefits-description1: We are looking for people who love music and sports to join our team and help us in our mission to connect Vietnamese people in Vancouver through arts and cultures.
benefits-description2: When joining VVF, you will have the opportunity to:
benefits-description3: As part of the team, you'll gain valuable experience, receive official certification, enjoy access to premium tools like Google Workspace and ChatGPT Plus and also discounts from our partners like 15% off Lululemon, and take part in fun events and exclusive discounts, etc. To learn more about these wonderful opportunities, click the button below!
benefits-item1: Gain experience in one or more fields of expertise that you are interested in.
benefits-item2: Get recognized by receiving a certification from VVF.
benefits-item3: Get access to multiple essential and modern technologies and applications for free such as:
benefits-subitem1: A work Google account with our domain in it (for example joe.smith@vietvibe.org).
benefits-subitem2: Access to all Google Workspace features (100 TB Google Drive, unlimited Google Meet, etc.).
benefits-subitem3: Access to Microsoft 365 Basics feature (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OneDrive, Teams, etc.) or discount on premium features such as Power BI (up to 70% off).
benefits-subitem7: Staff discount when join in any courses or events from VVF.
benefits-subitem9: Participate in exciting events such as hiking, camping, board games night and more with us.
benefits-subitemMore: And so much more. Click "See More" button below to see all benefits.
job-note: *Please note: we are a non-profit organization therefore all positions are non-paid. All the profits from our events will be used to support our following events/missions/bonding parties and will be publicly disclosed.
